convert_model: convert a Hugging Face model to Core ML format with configurable compute units and quantization
export_coreml_model: export a Hugging Face Transformers model to Core ML using the CLI with model ID and output path
validate_model_outputs: validate exported Core ML model outputs against the original Hugging Face model with absolute tolerance
run_seq2seq_conversion: run encoder and decoder conversion for seq2seq models like text2text-generation or speech-seq2seq
use_past_decoding: export a model with precomputed hidden states for fast autoregressive decoding using the use_past flag
